facts.fact: The National Registration Act [Chapter 10:17], an Act of Parliament commenced 24 September 1976, sets up the Registrar-General of National Registration, a register of residents and identity documents, and the consolidated text is stated as up to date as at 31 December 2016.

note: No cover fact: the text names fingerprints and a photograph but does not state a biometric register, a unique number or electronic checking.
